status: provisional (PFM 1A, 12 Nov 26): AF values from the archived 2013 AF Trademark color page via search summary; confirm against go.md Task 12 sources before final
source: AFI 84-105 (1 Apr 2025) 3.7.5.3: official AF colors are ultramarine blue/reflex blue and AF yellow. Review: docs/reviews/2026-11-12-color-sources.md
rules: primary is the dominant color: title slides, headings, table headers, app header
accentFill (AF yellow) only as a fill under ink text, or as text on primary; never text or thin lines on white (1.42:1)
warning (dark orange) for gates, cautions and step numbers; 5.43:1 on white
red, amber and green only for status and risk levels, one meaning each
every text pair meets WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text and UI parts); tests/check_palette.py measures it
